messages.content: 我正在嘗試根據“Pantone”標準找出顏色“天藍色”的RGB值。其次，我有興趣購買一把在“洛杉磯”出售的二手“Fender Stratocaster”吉他，狀況為“良好”。你能幫我查詢價格嗎？最後，我正在紐約組織一場國際象棋錦標賽，我正在尋找最佳的選手邀請。你能幫我找出最低等級為2200的前15名選手嗎？

function.name: guitar_price_find
function.description: Retrieve the price of a specific used guitar model based on its condition and location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location where the guitar is being sold.

function.name: board_game_chess_get_top_players
function.description: Find top chess players in a location based on rating. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city you want to find the players from.

minimum_rating.description: Minimum rating to filter the players.

number_of_players.description: Number of players you want to retrieve, default value is 10

function.name: identify_color_rgb
function.description: This function identifies the RGB values of a named color. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

standard.description: The color standard (e.g. basic, pantone). Default is 'basic'
